citation.title: Genuine multientropy, dihedral invariants, and Lifshitz theory

paper_results.R1_genuine_multientropy_reduction: G^(3)_n(A:B:C) = (2-n)/(2n) * [I_{1/2}(A:B) - 2 * E(A:B)] for Lifshitz / stabilizer-class states (Eq. 23 of paper)
paper_results.R2_n2_vanishing: G^(3)_2(A:B:C) = 0 for Lifshitz / stabilizer states (Markov gap M_{2,2} = 0)
paper_results.R3_GHZ_extraction_count: (I_{1/2} - 2*E) counts the number of GHZ states extractable from a stabilizer state (Discussion section of paper)
paper_results.R4_dihedral_reflected_equivalence: D_{2n}(A:B) = S^R_{2,n}(A:C) (Eq. 40 of paper; isomorphism Eq. 38)
paper_results.R5_CCNR_realignment: log Z_{2n} = E^CCNR_n(A:C); unnormalized dihedral = Rényi CCNR negativity of realignment (Eq. 41 of paper)

CR262_carrier_container.structure: carrier {m₃, D², Θ, ĥV} vs container {R, V, F}
CR262_carrier_container.identity: binary Z=N nucleus stability cipher (8/8 verified)

identifications.I1_substrate_states_stabilizer_class: SAM substrate states are stabilizer-class in the technical sense of Bravyi-Fattal-Gottesman (Ref. [81] of paper); the partition algebra ĥ^i·d̂^j acts as a closed group of discrete operations on integer occupation states. Consequence: paper Result 1 (Eq. 23) applies to SAM tripartitions.
identifications.I2_C12_GHZ_symmetric_anchor: C-12 has (u, d, e) = (Θ, Θ, m₃) = (18, 18, 6); u = d holds exactly. Under stabilizer-class state model with u-d symmetry, paper Result 2 gives G^(3)_2(C-12) = 0. Consistent with m(C-12) = 12 by definition; extends CR262 chain-step identification.
identifications.I3_A_operator_implements_dihedral_reflec: CR256's A-conjugate (sign flip on 1 ± p/R^(d+1)) is a reflected-construction operation on the partition algebra. By paper Result 4 (Eq. 40), this is equivalent to a dihedral-group permutation. Therefore A-operator's matter↔antimatter map IS the SAM analog of dihedral invariant D_{2n}.
identifications.I4_CR229_inclusion_exclusion_is_triparti: R² = M + Θ = ℒ − Θ is structurally inclusion-exclusion on a tripartite system with two 81-element sides and an 18-element overlap. Under I1, paper Result 1 applies to this tripartition; the genuine multientropy at n=2 of this tripartition vanishes by Result 2.
identifications.I5_containers_destructive_interference: CR262 carrier/container distinction maps to: containers (R, V, F) force destructive interference in reflected-construction permutations (paper Result 4); the resulting reflected entropy is incompatible with bound-state stability. Carriers (m₃, D², Θ, ĥV) admit stable GHZ-extractable structure.
